items.label: Multi-functional
items.value: This dog crate furniture is endowed with multi-purpose use for its furniture look. It can be a doghouse as well as be an end table, tea table or nightstand. Why not put a potted plant on top or place some pet supplies? Modern rustic look makes this pet cage compatible with your home

items.label: Double Openings and Pull-Out Tray
items.value: This furniture-style dog kennel indoor has front and side openings for access.The intensive bottom net of this dog kennel protects your pet's feet from injuries, and the pull-out tray can effectively prevent the garbage from falling, which is convenient for you to clean up

items.label: Ample Activity Space
items.value: The overall size is 38.6"L x 25.6"W x 26.9"H, and the size of inner house is 32.9"L x 23.8"W x 23.2"H. This dog crate loads up to 90 lb, highly suitable for medium and large dogs. Please confirm the size of your dog before purchasing this dog cage

items.label: Sturdy and Chew-Resistant
items.value: It is constructed of particleboard and steel, featuring easy care, strong stability and chew-resistance for pet-safe durability and long service life. We simplified assembly methods and steps and with numbered parts and comprehensible instructions, you can assemble this wooden dog crate easily

items.label: Warm Home for Your Dog
items.value: HOOBRO’s comfortable kennel is a warm home, which elevates peace and relaxation for your dog.so it can enjoy time in the end table dog crate when you are out without destroying anything in the house and will happily wait for your back. It can be a canine companion, but also an attraction in your bedroom or living room

items.value: Chewproof, Comfortable, Durable, Easy Assembly, Lockable

items.value: Alloy Steel, Engineered Wood, Iron, Metal
